title: Butter vanilla loaf
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original food illustration for a recipe card. Subject: Butter vanilla loaf. Ingredient reference: Flour, Sugar, Eggs, Butter, Milk, Vanilla extract, Baking powder. Preparation reference: One batch makes 8 portions. Preparation: 20 minutes; cooking: 45 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 10 minutes. Heat the oven to 170 C conventional. Use 10 g of the butter to grease a 20 cm loaf tin. Soften the remaining butter and beat it with the sugar for 3 minutes until pale. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla extract and milk. Fold in the flour and baking powder just until no dry flour remains. Spoon into the tin and bake on the middle shelf for 40 to 45 minutes, until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 10 minutes before turning out and cutting into eight slices..
